note: Role fitness (docs/CONTRACT.md Phase 6c slice VOC §2.3): one predicate per role over the generated facts. It never changes which block a generator writes; it only reports (M27:role, validateBible's warnings). A row's block fits when every check in `all` holds and, if given, at least one in `any`; `every` applies to every role, a role with no row included. K1, T3 and H's slots resolve to roles and take their role's predicate. The checks are evaluated by kit/lib/vocab.mjs fitsRole() on the block's default state.

checks.stairsSlab: the block (or the full block behind a stairs or slab id) has stairs and slab variants (kit.mjs variant())
checks.floor: an entity can stand on it (blocks.mjs isFloor)
checks.emits: emits light (L > 0) in its default state or a lit state
checks.glass: lets light through (optics C) and is a full block or a pane
checks.thin: thin collision (a fence, wall, pane or bars)
checks.natural: a natural voxel class (ROCK, SOIL, LOOSE, SNOW, ICE)
checks.obtainable: its survival class is not none

rows.why: a gravity or partial block in a load role falls or leaks light
a roof is laid in its stairs and slabs (palette() already demands them), and a falling roof falls
W's finding: gravel paths leave gravity blocks over gaps
a light gives light (the bible frame test already catches a dark light)
M8's barrier: a rail stops a fall and is not walked over
terrain ops write them as ground

every.why: a creative-only role can't build in survival
